Format LOGOS source files.

Applies the canonical style (4-space indentation, no tabs, no trailing whitespace) — the same rules the language server uses. Without paths, formats the whole project; with paths, exactly those files. `--check` writes nothing and exits 1 if anything would change.

Usage: largo fmt [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...
          Specific files to format (defaults to all project sources)

Options:
      --check
          Check only: list files that need formatting, exit 1 if any

      --json
          With --check: print one `logos-fmt/1` JSON envelope on stdout

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo fmt
  largo fmt src/main.lg
  largo fmt --check    # CI gate, writes nothing
